data.description:
## Incident Overview
Live e2e_field_validation_probe run 2026-06-06: all 10 Phase-6a passes reported 'mutations=-1' and PASSED. -1 is the awk fallback sentinel (mut_count=${mut_count:--1} at ~line 1733). The awk pattern /^filter: [0-9]+ mutations computed, [0-9]+ match filter/ never matched the reconciler output in Phase 6a, so the check '[ "$mut_count" -le $PHASE6A_MAX_PASS_MUTATIONS ]' is vacuously true (-1 <= 2). Phase 6a (interleaved bidirectional idempotency, bug b859 Part 4b) is therefore NOT actually validating convergence.

## Contrast
Phase 6 uses FILTER_IDS_9 and correctly read 0. Phase 6a uses $FILTER_IDS (run_filtered_reconciler "$FILTER_IDS") — likely FILTER_IDS is empty/unset in that scope so the reconciler runs unfiltered and emits no 'filter:' line (the line is only printed when filter_local_ids is non-empty, reconcile.py post-filter block), or the run errors before it.

## Fix direction
Populate FILTER_IDS for Phase 6a (or reuse FILTER_IDS_9), AND treat the -1 sentinel as a FAILURE (no-match must not pass) so a broken counter can never report green. Discovered during dcf3 live investigation.
data.title: [e2e_field_validation_probe.sh/Phase-6a]: idempotency counter reads -1 sentinel for all 10 passes -> <=2 assertions vacuous (never validates convergence)
